responsibility: Implements builtin #[derive(Clone)] expansion for the Rust front end. This file synthesizes AST impl items for Clone by constructing the clone method body and trait implementation with AST::Builder, generating per-field Clone::clone calls for tuple and record structs, special handling for unit structs and unions, and issuing an unsupported diagnostic for enums, ultimately producing the inserted TraitImpl item returned to macro expansion.
same_name_distinction: Implements the Clone-specific derive expander by constructing the synthesized clone method body and impl items for structs, tuple structs, and unions, with enum rejection. Unlike the paired header, this .cc contains the AST-building code for Clone derivation rather than just the DeriveClone class declaration.
